intro.title: Design and quality in every project.
intro.text: At Arquelia we transform homes into unique spaces, designed for those who want something more. We combine years of experience, top-quality materials and careful attention to detail to deliver exclusive renovations and an experience worthy of every project.

servicesGrid.title: Our services
servicesGrid.lead: We design renovations with a comprehensive approach, taking care of every detail to create functional, elegant and long-lasting spaces.

projectsShowcase.title: Projects
projectsShowcase.lead: Every renovation is a chance to turn a space into something unique. At Arquelia we take care of every detail to create work that combines function, aesthetics and flawless execution.

items.title: Full Renovation
items.desc: Every finish was crafted down to the last millimetre: natural stone flooring, made-to-measure joinery and integrated home automation, striking a balance between classic architecture and contemporary comfort.

items.title: Kitchen and Bathroom Renovation
items.desc: A complete kitchen and bathroom renovation with top-quality materials and a layout designed for everyday life.

items.title: Facade Restoration

items.title: Parquet Flooring
items.desc: Natural parquet flooring installed with a seamless finish, bringing warmth and light to the whole space.

steps.desc: We visit the space, listen to what you need and assess the real scope of the project. No cost, no obligation.

intro.lead: Arquelia was born from the will to do things properly, with no shortcuts.
intro.p1: Behind every project is a team that treats construction as a craft of precision, where how we treat the client matters as much as the last finish on site. We renovate homes, premises and offices across Catalonia under the legal name
intro.p2: We don't work by volume. We take on the projects we can genuinely deliver, with our own team and the time each job deserves. That means fewer jobs at once, and more attention on each one.

items.title: Mastery

items.title: Materials
items.desc: We choose noble materials and trusted suppliers. Direct relationships with manufacturers let us access top quality at a price that makes sense.

items.title: Method
items.desc: A single point of contact and a clear process, from the first visit to handover. Fixed quote, realistic schedule and weekly communication.

sections.heading: 1. What are cookies?
sections.body: Cookies are small text files that a website may store in your browser or device when you visit it. The same legal regime also covers other data storage and retrieval technologies, such as the browser's local storage (localStorage), which this website uses instead of actual cookies for the single purpose described below.

sections.heading: 2. Types of cookies by purpose
sections.body: Technical or necessary: essential for the site to work and to provide the requested service (for example, remembering your language). Personalisation: allow preferences such as language or region to be remembered. Analytics: allow visitor numbers and site usage to be measured. Advertising or third-party: allow ad spaces to be managed or information to be shared with social networks and other external platforms.

sections.heading: 3. Types of cookies by ownership and duration
sections.body: Depending on who manages them, cookies can be first-party (managed by Arquelia) or third-party (managed by a party other than Arquelia). Depending on how long they remain active, they can be session cookies (deleted when you close your browser) or persistent cookies (stored for a set period).

sections.heading: 4. What we use on this website
sections.body: This website only uses its own, persistent technical storage: the language you select (Spanish or English), saved in your browser's local storage so you don't have to choose it again on every visit. We do not install analytics, advertising or social-media cookies or similar technologies, and we do not share browsing data with third parties. Should analytical or third-party cookies be added in the future, your prior consent will be requested via the corresponding notice, and this policy will be updated accordingly.

sections.heading: 5. Legal basis
sections.body: This processing is based on article 22.2 of Spanish Law 34/2002, on Information Society Services and Electronic Commerce (LSSI-CE), which exempts cookies and equivalent technologies that are strictly necessary to provide a service expressly requested by the user from the duty to obtain consent. For this reason, this website’s cookie notice lets you accept or reject, but your choice does not affect the site’s operation while no non-essential cookies are in use.

sections.heading: 6. Managing or withdrawing your consent
sections.body: You can accept or reject the use of non-essential cookies from the notice shown on your first visit. You can change your choice at any time from the "Cookie settings" link available in this website’s footer, which will show the notice again.

sections.heading: 7. Configuring your browser
sections.body: In addition to the options above, you can allow, block or delete cookies installed on your device through your browser settings: in Chrome, via Settings > Privacy and security > Cookies; in Firefox, via Settings > Privacy & Security; in Safari, via Preferences > Privacy; and in Edge, via Settings > Privacy, search and services. If you block all cookies, some parts of the site may not work correctly.

sections.heading: 8. Changes to this policy
sections.body: Arquelia may amend this cookie policy in response to legislative requirements or to align it with guidance from the Spanish Data Protection Agency. We recommend reviewing it each time you visit the website.
